7.2.4.11.8 Rte_Rips_NotifyTxConfirmation
[SWS_Rte_05312] Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTxConfir-
mation_<CGI> ⌈
Service Name
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTxConfirmation_<CGI>
Syntax
void Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTxConfirmation_<CGI> (
CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId,
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0107
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant
ComUserCbkHandleId
Handle Id of the Com user callback invoking the API
Parameters (in)
result
E_OK: The PDU was transmitted.
E_NOT_OK: Transmission of the PDU failed.
▽
△
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Rte_Rips_NotifyTxConfirmation is used to provide confirmation or failure of transmission to the
RTE Implementation Plug-In for the related LdCom signal used for the Data Communication
Graph.This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom_IF Rte_LdComCbkTx
Confirmation callback. See requirement [SWS_Com_00124] for more details on the
functionality of this callback.
Available via
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
⌋
[SWS_Rte_05313]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00312, SRS_Rte_00317

provide the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTxConfirmation_<CGI> Service for
